name: Venture Undersuit Envy
description: Whether you’re discovering bold new frontiers or simply stretching your legs after a long spaceflight, Robert Space Industries’ Venture Explorer Suit takes vacuum-safe wear to the next level with its incorporation of top-of-class safety features seamlessly blended with phenomenal freedom of movement. This special Envy edition inspired by the Coramor festival features a vibrant pink and purple color scheme for the most enthusiastic of lovers.
